steps.title: Establish App Meta-Configuration
steps.description: Verify application meta-descriptor containing target app name 'Voice Control Assistant' and package identifier 'com.voicecontrolassistant.app'.

steps.title: Configure Accessibility Service Rules
steps.description: Configure the retrieval of interactive window contents and view resource IDs to enable programmatic navigation on the viewport.

steps.title: Declare Hardware and System Camera Permissions
steps.description: Add camera and flashlight permission controls to AndroidManifest.xml for managing torch features programmatically.

steps.title: Design AI Settings and Manual Trigger UI Layout
steps.description: Integrate Gemini AI configuration settings (API Key input, Model spinner, Custom Model field) and Manual command trigger layouts in activity_main.xml.

steps.title: Implement AI Configuration & Manual Executer in MainActivity
steps.description: Configure settings retention using SharedPreferences and implement dynamic intent dispatcher in MainActivity.java to forward manual commands directly to the active service.

steps.title: Set up On-Demand Command Processing in Accessibility Service
steps.description: Add onStartCommand hook in VoiceAccessibilityService to intercept and execute text commands sent programmatically via system intents.

steps.title: Integrate Gemini AI Request Dispatcher
steps.description: Implement safe background thread network routine using HttpURLConnection to query the Gemini generateContent API securely.

steps.title: Create Prompt Parser & JSON Schema Validator
steps.description: Develop strict client-side JSON schema parsing and verification routines to validate Gemini instructions and reject partial or invalid execution pipelines.

steps.title: Connect Voice Input Pipeline to Gemini Engine
steps.description: Modify the voice SpeechRecognizer listener to dynamically stream raw utterances directly into the new Gemini AI natural language interpreter.

steps.title: Add Asynchronous Sleep WAIT Command Support
steps.description: Introduce dynamic WAIT commands inside the sequential action execution chain using non-blocking main-thread Handler postDelayed triggers.

steps.title: Building Voice Control Assistant
steps.description: Assemble, compile, and build the updated Voice Control Assistant using Gradle command line utilities.
